verdict.rationale: Poly documents strong versioning and rollback for files and folders: Flashback, per-file version history, undoing a specific change, and preserving the original when the agent edits a file. None of this applies to automations themselves. The evidence shows no saved automation, workflow, or agent-task definition that a user can version, review, or roll back. Rolling back the files an agent changed is an adjacent capability, and storing scripts as versioned files would be a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit for this story.
